{{Youmay|the epic|''[[Spirit of the Republic]]'', the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]}}
'''Spirit of the Republic''' was an epic made by the composer [[Noj Smialliw]]. The only known copy of it was on sale in [[Nenmo's Curios]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
